scope: Purposive full-text audit of three included primary papers. Does not recode the authoritative snapshot or expand N.

studies.version: arXiv:2510.03667v2, 2026-02-10; linked by title and five matching authors
studies.design: Within-participant high versus low sycophancy chatbots; 24 novices; two ML debugging tasks.

measures_and_locations.measure: Computational evaluation: accuracy and belief validation on 80 misconceived and 80 open queries; MMLU college/high-school CS, 100 questions each
measures_and_locations.role: System evaluation/control validation, not a recipient outcome

measures_and_locations.measure: Workflow events and appropriate/inappropriate reliance, including actual code changes
Likert perceptions including helpfulness, reliability, enjoyment and perceived task improvement
measures_and_locations.role: Subjective ratings, distinct from objective gains

measures_and_locations.measure: Held-out F1 gain normalized as (participant - baseline)/(fixed reference - baseline)

suggested_review: User opinion unmarked despite explicit RQ3
User action unmarked despite workflow/reliance measures
System performance unmarked despite computational evaluations; decide consistently whether baseline/validation measures qualify
studies.limits: Do not turn a non-significant comparison against zero into proof of no benefit. Do not generalize a novice debugging result to all sycophancy. Original labels preserved.

studies.version: arXiv:2512.08937v2, 2026-02-28; author version associated with published DOI
studies.design: Study 1: 161 raters in advice-giving occupations compare GPT-4o, GPT-5, top Reddit and 90th-percentile Reddit replies. Study 2: 49 raters compare source by editing-pipeline conditions.

measures_and_locations.measure: Perceived effectiveness, clarity, warmth/support, contextual fit, sycophancy and future advice-seeking intention
Overall best and expected long-term benefit rankings
measures_and_locations.role: Hypothetical future benefit, not observed longitudinal outcomes

measures_and_locations.reported_direction: LLM advice generally preferred to human baselines on perceived quality; whole-source comparison does not isolate sycophancy

measures_and_locations.role: 161 + 49 = 210 raters in the two main studies; no demonstrated recipient well-being improvement

suggested_review: Retain labels pending author decision; clarify that System performance includes perceived advice quality, not necessarily objective effectiveness
Distinguish third-party raters from actual advice recipients
studies.limits: No automated recoding. No claim that favorable quality ratings establish actual user task success.

studies.version: arXiv:2502.10844v3, 2026-02-02; author version associated with published DOI
studies.design: 2 x 2 between-participant experiment, 224 analyzed U.S. adults, autonomous-vehicle discussion; stance adaptive/consistent crossed with demeanor complimentary/neutral.

measures_and_locations.role: Complimentary language is already marked Obsequiousness in FINAL MAP

measures_and_locations.measure: Cognitive trust, affective trust, continued-use/recommendation intentions, issue attitudes
measures_and_locations.role: Broad User opinion; intentions are not observed action

measures_and_locations.reported_direction: F(1,217)=4.58, p=.033. Complimentary: adaptive 3.55 vs consistent 4.03; neutral: adaptive 4.09 vs consistent 3.71.

suggested_review: No proposed behavior correction; retain broad opinion label and explain issue-attitude coverage
studies.limits: Do not call intention observed behavior or authenticity objective correctness. Section 4.2 text claims all mediation paths significant although the reported affective-trust CI crosses zero; manuscript avoids that claim.

external_background.checked_sections: Main text pp.1-3 and 8-9; appendix Table 5 and Table 6
external_background.overlap: Already reviews 70 papers, surveys 106 experts, maps definitions and operationalizations, and discusses downstream effects. Our distinction is the narrower outcome cross-tabulation and an explicit measure-level audit, not a first taxonomy or first link to consequences.
